t: Makita DHP489STJ combi drill delivers heavy-duty drilling and screwdriving performance with a brushless motor and 2-speed gearbox. Trade professionals such as carpenters and construction workers can rely on the robust tool for intensive site applications. The durable all-metal gears produce up to 73Nm of torque, whilst a variable speed trigger and 21 torque settings plus drill and hammer modes offer precise control. Extreme Protection Technology provides dust and water resistance for demanding outdoor environments. Compact 175mm length allows access to confined spaces, supported by a bright LED work light. Also equipped with an electronic brake which stops the motor instantly for safety and speed. Automatic spindle lock and 13mm keyless chuck ensure quick bit changes. Low battery indicator monitors power levels during operation. Supplied with 2 x 5.0Ah lithium-ion batteries, standard charger and MAKPAC carry case.
